name: shift-composer
title: Shift Composer
description: A chat input that reshapes itself between typing, a drop zone for files and links, and a voice recorder. Drag a file over it and the drop zone opens on its own. Send turns into stop while a reply is on its way, and next steps slide into the toolbar after.
blurb: A chat input that reshapes itself for typing, files or your voice.
note: try the mic, or drop a file on it
